name: @jaggerxtrm/substrate
description: Durable work substrate: issue graph over SQLite/WAL (library-first; sb CLI consumes this). Published copies ship prebuilt JavaScript and run on Node >=24 or Bun >=1.3; from a source checkout the entry points are TypeScript and run directly, with no build
